name: Isabel
source: Born in the United Kingdom and living in the United States, Isabel is a systems engineer specialising in artificial intelligence software and robotics. She works alongside Kathy in the lab where they develop specialised drones. She speaks little, and by the time she does she has already thought ten steps ahead.
